title: Ignition, Inc.: Mac MSP Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com
URL: https://ignitionit.com
APPLY HERE: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/bLvP56CvGHU
Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first
TL;DR
ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.
We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.
What the actual job???
Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”
You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.
In a typical week, you might:
Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.
Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.
Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.
Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.
Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."
⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.
About ignitionit.com
We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!
What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.
We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.
If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.
The tech you'll work with (and grow into)
Day one, you'll be living in:
Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)
Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows
Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles
Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)
Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client
The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling
⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.
Who we hope you are
The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:
Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)
Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband
Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem
Have at least 2 years of IT support experience on the job. Go-getters who are just getting started and can prove they have a deep, demonstrable history of teaching themselves technology for the sheer joy of it might also make the cut.
⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:
Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people
Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time
Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it
Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line
Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former
Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)
Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)
Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously
Regarding AI
Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.
Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.
Compensation & logistics
Base salary: For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market.
Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.
Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.
How to apply
The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:
Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.
If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.
From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.
If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?
Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-mac-msp-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

title: Stripe: Strategy and Operations Lead, Deal Pricing
description:
Headquarters: New York City, Washington DC, Remote
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
Deal Pricing is a dedicated global function that provides deal pricing expertise, financial insights, and deal support for negotiated users to Stripe's global Go-to-Market teams. We work to ensure deals create economic value for Stripe by establishing the deal commercial framework for a scaling sales organization, actively supporting large and strategic deals, and providing pricing insights and feedback to sales, finance, and product leaders. Deal Pricing frequently works with cross-functional business partners across Operations, Finance and Strategy, and Product. There is constant collaboration with Deal Pricing colleagues across all regions.
Rather than pricing individual deals, this Strategy and Operations (S&O) role acts as a central engine behind the global deal pricing team. You’ll serve as a "Chief of Staff" function to Deal Pricing leadership—owning the global operating model, driving cross-functional process excellence, managing our strategic operating rhythm, and codifying our commercial knowledge so Stripe can scale its GTM velocity.
What you’ll do
Strategic planning and operating rhythm
Drive strategy execution. Translate high-level annual goals into actionable quarterly OKRs, ensuring clear ownership and measurable progress.
Manage the operating cadence. Facilitate the team’s operating rhythm (MBRs, QBRs, and leadership syncs) to drive accountability, surface risks, and unblock cross-functional dependencies.
Strategic telemetry and insights. Collaborate with our tooling and analytics team to track functional performance, using data to inform pricing strategy, operational pivots, and executive decision-making.
Commercial governance and friction management
Optimize cross-functional SLAs. Act as the primary bridge between Sales velocity and risk-mitigation functions (Deal Strategy, Finance, Treasury). Define and enforce SLAs for deal pricing approvals to ensure global consistency.
Resolve bottlenecks. Proactively identify process friction, working with partner ops teams to redesign playbooks and clarify decision-making boundaries.
Knowledge infrastructure and sales enablement
Codify the "Deal pricing playbook." Build and maintain a single source of truth for deal pricing frameworks, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring documentation is version-controlled and highly discoverable.
Scale sales self-service. Partner with Sales Enablement to translate complex commercial policies into self-serve guides and playbooks, empowering Sales to execute simple deals independently.
Process and AI architecture
Systems roadmap. Act as a lead for our CRM and CPQ evolution, transforming manual, spreadsheet-based pricing into automated, scalable workflows.
Deploy AI for efficiency. Proactively identify and implement AI and LLM solutions to accelerate operations—including automating documentation, summarizing legacy contract terms, and extracting data from unstructured sales communications.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

title: Twitch: Creator Outreach Associate Contractor (Brazilian Portuguese Fluency)
description:
Headquarters: Remote (United States)
About Us :
Twitch is the world's biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.
We're about community, inside and out. You'll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We're on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we're up to on LinkedIn and X , and discover the projects we're solving on our Blog .
About the Role:
Twitch is searching for a Brazilian Portuguese-speaking Creator Outreach Associate to identify, persuade, and successfully onboard emerging Portuguese-speaking talent to the Twitch livestreaming community. As the ideal candidate, you are fascinated by creator communities and stay on the cutting edge of creator and influencer trends and cultural moments. You are fluent in the ever-evolving language of creators and influencers. You know where the next generation of live streamers will be found, how to get them to Twitch, and how to get them set up and streaming successfully. You'll be determined, organized, methodical, and have a deep personal drive to see new creators succeed on Twitch. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, be quick to learn, and always look for new ways to improve your work. You'll work hand in hand with the Brazil team to bring creators to the service. This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role: you'll be responsible for reaching out to a weekly target of new creators and guiding them through to their first stream. Targets may adjust over time with business needs. This is a fixed-term contract position based in the United States, ending mid-December 2026.
You Will:
Search widely across platforms and communities to spot emerging talent, understand what's resonating culturally, and proactively reach out to creators who could thrive on Twitch.
Initiate confident cold outreach and persuade creators to see Twitch as an exciting, meaningful next step in their careers.
Stay deeply plugged into creator trends, rising influencers, new platforms, and cultural moments that shape where audiences gather.
Guide creators through their earliest steps on Twitch—making onboarding clear, supportive, and geared toward getting them confidently to their first stream.
Work hand in hand with the Brazil team to identify, engage, and bring Brazilian Portuguese-speaking creators to the service.
Own each creator relationship from first outreach through their first stream, then hand off to a Strategic Partner Manager with clear context (creator background, onboarding notes, first-stream feedback) for ongoing development.
Manage your outreach pipeline in a CRM—logging touchpoints, updating lead status, and keeping records clean.
Validate leads before outreach (confirm follower counts, check a creator isn't already assigned) to keep the pipeline accurate and avoid duplicate outreach.
You Have:
Must be based in the United States and legally authorized to work and be paid in the US for the duration of the contract.
Fully fluent in Engish and Brazilian Portuguese (spoken and written) with the ability to conduct outreach and build relationships with Brazilian Portuguese-speaking creators.
Ability to work hours aligned to Brazil's time zone, at minimum, to collaborate with the Brazil team and creators.
Prior experience in a quota-carrying outreach, sales, or talent-scouting role.
Proven interest and knowledge in one of: creator support, lead generation, influencer marketing, or community management.
A genuine passion for livestreaming and internet culture, and a strong understanding of the creator economy—including where creators are rising across platforms (Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.) and what's driving content trends.
Determination to find and bring new creators to Twitch, and to support and grow them, with a deep desire to help shape the future of the platform.
Comfort with CRM and creator-analytics tools, or the ability to learn them quickly, to manage a pipeline and source creators efficiently.
Bonus Points
Personal experience as a live streamer or content creator, familiarity with live streaming tools and software.
Existing relationships with a wide variety of Brazilian Portguese-speaking content creators across platforms.
Intimate knowledge of the Brazilian creator landscape and Portuguese-speaking creator communities.
Location(s): Remote- United States
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $31/hour in our lowest geographic market and up to $39/hour in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
#LI-Remote
Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
Twitch values your privacy. Please consult our Candidate Privacy Notice , for information about how we collect, use, and disclose personal information of our candidates.
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twitch-creator-outreach-associate-contractor-brazilian-portuguese-fluency

Accuracy and attention to detail

$26,200 — $58,950 USD

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
work from anywhere
flexible paid time off
flexible working hours (we are async )
16 weeks paid parental leave
mental health support services
stock options
learning budget
home office budget & IT equipment
budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async .
You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.
If that sounds like something you want, apply now!
How to apply
Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.

Zapiet helps Shopify merchants offer exceptional pickup, delivery and shipping experiences.
Our products are used by more than 10,000 merchants around the world, from independent businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands. We are a remote, bootstrapped SaaS company with ambitious plans for the next stage of our growth.
We are looking for a commercially focused Head of Marketing to help more merchants discover, adopt and succeed with Zapiet’s products.
The role
As Head of Marketing, your primary responsibility will be to increase revenue by driving awareness, adoption and continued use of Zapiet’s products.
You will turn our wider company and marketing strategy into focused campaigns that generate measurable results. You will own the marketing funnel, from discovery and acquisition through to activation, expansion and retention.
You will also manage and grow a team of internal and external specialists across email marketing, SEO, answer engine optimisation, content, communications and other marketing disciplines.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable setting strategy, managing specialists, analysing performance and stepping in to help execute when needed.
You will work closely with our CMO, CEO, product, sales, partnerships and customer support teams.
Your responsibilities
Increase product adoption and revenue
Develop and deliver marketing plans that increase installations, product adoption and recurring revenue.
Identify the biggest opportunities within our acquisition, activation, retention and expansion funnels.
Create campaigns that clearly communicate how Zapiet’s products help merchants increase revenue, reduce costs and improve their operations.
Increase adoption across Zapiet’s complete product portfolio through cross-selling, product education and lifecycle marketing.
Support new product and feature launches with clear positioning, messaging and go-to-market plans.
Develop campaigns for specific industries, merchant segments and geographic markets.
Turn merchant success stories into compelling case studies, campaigns and sales materials.
Own marketing performance
Set clear targets and KPIs for every marketing channel.
Build reporting that connects marketing activity to installations, qualified opportunities, product adoption and recurring revenue.
Monitor performance across the full funnel and identify where merchants are dropping off.
Run structured experiments to improve conversion, activation and retention.
Manage the marketing budget and allocate resources to the channels producing the strongest commercial results.
Report performance, insights and priorities directly to the CMO and CEO.
Lead and grow the marketing team
Manage and develop a team of specialists across email marketing, SEO, AEO, content and communications.
Recruit additional expertise as the marketing function grows.
Set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations.
Create an environment where specialists can do their best work while remaining accountable for measurable outcomes.
Coordinate internal team members, agencies, freelancers and technology partners.
Ensure campaigns are delivered on time and to a consistently high standard.
Strengthen Zapiet’s market position
Refine the positioning and messaging of Zapiet and its products.
Improve Zapiet’s visibility across search engines, AI answer platforms, industry publications and the wider Shopify ecosystem.
Build relationships with Shopify agencies, technology partners, influencers and ecommerce communities.
Identify emerging changes in SaaS marketing, ecommerce discovery and merchant buying behaviour.
Ensure Zapiet’s communications are clear, distinctive and consistent across every channel.
What we are looking for
Significant experience marketing SaaS products, ideally within ecommerce, Shopify or B2B software.
A proven record of increasing product adoption, recurring revenue or qualified pipeline through marketing.
Experience leading and developing a multidisciplinary marketing team.
Strong knowledge of lifecycle and email marketing, SEO, content, communications and product marketing.
A practical understanding of answer engine optimisation and how AI is changing product discovery.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market plans for products and features.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect marketing activity with commercial results.
Experience setting targets, managing budgets and reporting performance to senior leadership.
Excellent project management skills and the ability to keep multiple campaigns moving.
Native-level written and spoken English, with exceptional attention to detail.
A willingness to be hands-on and take ownership of outcomes.
You will do well in this role if you
Think about revenue and product adoption, not vanity metrics.
Can turn a broad strategy into a focused and achievable plan.
Understand how acquisition, activation, retention and expansion work together.
Are comfortable challenging assumptions and testing new ideas.
Know how to lead experts without needing to be the deepest specialist in every discipline.
Communicate openly, make decisions using evidence and take responsibility for results.
Enjoy working in a fast-moving, international and remote environment.
How success will be measured
Your performance will be assessed against agreed commercial and marketing targets, which may include:
Growth in marketing-attributed recurring revenue.
Growth in product installations and qualified merchant opportunities.
Improvements in trial-to-paid and install-to-activation conversion.
Increased adoption of additional Zapiet products.
Growth in organic, email, partner and AI-assisted discovery channels.
Merchant retention and expansion revenue.
The performance and development of the marketing team.
Efficient use of the marketing budget.
A performance-related bonus will be paid based on the achievement of agreed targets.
What we offer
A salary of £40,000–£50,000 per year, depending on experience.
A performance-related bonus.
Remote and flexible working.
The opportunity to shape the marketing strategy of an established, international SaaS company.
Direct access to Zapiet’s CMO and CEO.
The freedom to build a talented marketing team and introduce new ideas.
The opportunity to work with Shopify merchants, agencies and technology partners around the world.
Equal opportunities
Zapiet welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds. We make hiring decisions based on experience, ability and the contribution each person can make to our team.
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zapiet-head-of-marketing

You'll take pride in restoring items affected by fire, water, and mold while guiding teammates, mastering specialized equipment, and making a real impact on every project.
A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A CONTENTS CREW LEAD
As a Contents Crew Lead, no two days are ever the same. One morning you might be restoring treasured family photos, and by afternoon you could be cleaning specialized equipment or mentoring a new team member. You roll up your sleeves and dive into each job with focus and pride, using advanced tools and cleaning systems to bring belongings back to life. You track and photograph contents, keep meticulous records, and make sure every item is handled with care. You troubleshoot, problem-solve, and stay one step ahead to keep projects on schedule. You take ownership of your work and lead by example, creating a positive, efficient, and safe environment for your team. Every day, your skill, energy, and attention to detail help turn chaos into calm for clients when they need it most.

Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational and teamwork skills
Ability to guide and support Contents Technician I team members
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and comfortable using mobile devices and apps

Additional certifications considered an asset: Commercial Carpet Cleaning (CCT), Carpet Repair and Reinstallation (RRT), Upholstery and Fabric Cleaning (UFT), and Applied Microbial Remediation (AMRT)
Valid driver's license and clean driving abstract
Must be able to participate in a rotating on-call scheduleâ¯â¯â¯

description:
Executive Operations & Project Manager
Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)
Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)
Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start
Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)
About Viva Wellness Drip
Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.
As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.
This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.
Position Overview
This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.
We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.
Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.
If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities:
Executive Operations
Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.
Project Management
Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.
Business Operations
Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
Coordinate communication between departments.
Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.
Cross-Functional Support
Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:
Business Development
Marketing
Operations
Clinical Services
Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
Inventory Management
Events & Corporate Wellness
You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.
Qualifications:
Required
Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.
Preferred
Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.
What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.
You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.
You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.
Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.
Compensation & Growth
This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.
The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.
Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.
Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?
At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.
Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.
If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.
## Role Overview
We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.
## Key Responsibilities
### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized
## Required Skills & Experience
- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
- Able to work autonomously and independently
- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
- Comfortable working European timezone hours
- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
- Comfortable using AI in workflow
## Nice to Have
- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest
## Benefits
- Remote, travel encouraged
- Credits for Outsite locations
- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

title: Customer.io: Director, Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Americas Remote
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . I'm looking for an experienced engineering leader to own several of Customer.io 's product development engineering teams. This is a role for someone whose primary job is business impact: you set clear goals, hold teams accountable to schedules, and personally drive complex initiatives to done. Your first mandate is a high-priority, executive-visible platform initiative — the kind of project where you'll set the direction, align the org, and carry it across the finish line yourself. If you're energized by making things happen inside an organization — not just managing the people who do — this role is for you.
About Customer.io
Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.
We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.
What We Value
Execution above all
Leading a team and driving impact are not the same job — yours is the second one, and the team is how you do it. You set direction, create accountability, and see initiatives through across an organization. When something must ship, you put it on your back.
Engineering leaders who go deep and wide
You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align executives on a roadmap and earn an engineering team's respect in the same day. You still read the code, join the incident channel, and know why the thing is late. You don't choose between vision and execution — you hold both.
A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"
You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait.
An AI-first engineering mindset
AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You've developed a real point of view on AI-native development, you can speak to it concretely, and you bring it into how your org operates.
What You'll Do
Own the vision, roadmap, and execution for major platform initiatives — starting with the delivery of our new billing platform, a high-visibility integration program spanning Engineering, Product, and Finance
Set clear goals and delivery milestones, hold teams accountable to them, and communicate progress crisply to executive stakeholders
Make build-vs-buy and sequencing decisions with conviction, and lead the team through them
Mentor and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders — with the bar that everyone on the team can articulate the impact they're driving
Drive a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across the org
Leverage AI tools to accelerate team velocity and bring an AI-native perspective to how the team builds
What We're Looking For
12+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time leading engineering teams
Experience managing engineering managers and/or senior technical leaders
A track record of driving complex, cross-functional initiatives to completion — you've taken something ambiguous and org-spanning and personally made it ship
Deep understanding of SaaS software architecture, cloud-native infrastructure, and the tradeoffs that come with building in-house vs. buying and integrating
Ability to translate technical complexity into clear strategy and communicate effectively with both engineers and executives
Demonstrated AI-native leadership — not just personal fluency, but a track record of bringing AI-first development practices into how your team works
Comfort operating in ambiguity and making difficult tradeoffs between competing priorities
You can articulate, specifically, what you made happen in your last role that wouldn't have happened without you
Bonus points for:
Experience in the domains of self-service and growth, audience segmentation, or customer data platforms (CDPs)
Exposure to billing, subscriptions, or monetization systems — useful context for your first mandate, not a requirement
Experience at high-growth SaaS companies; you have delivered results at a startup
Track record of shipping in high-velocity product orgs where your domain was treated as a first-class engineering concern
Compensation & Benefits
We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $230,000-$270,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.
We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave , unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.
See full benefits here →
Our Process
No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.
Application - We review everyone with care.
Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for, your leadership style, and how we work.
Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Deep dive into your experience leading teams, your technical philosophy, and how you think about building organizations.
People Partner Interview (60 mins) - Explore your leadership style, management philosophy, and approach to supporting high-performing teams with our engineering people partner.
Technical Interview (60 mins) - Engage in a collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.
Take-Home Assignment - Submit a short written retrospective on a project you’ve led as an Engineering Manager.
Retrospective Review Call (60 mins) - We’ll use your written submission as the foundation for a deeper conversation.
All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-director-engineering

title: Asana: Senior Privacy Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote
The Security team at Asana is responsible for protecting Asana’s employees, users, and customers . We build innovative safeguards to ensure that our data is protected against threats and that we comply with legal, regulatory, and customer requirements while collaborating closely with teams across the organization . Reporting to Asana’s Head of Global Privacy, Data Protection, and Compliance, as a founding member of the Privacy Engineering team, you will shape how we build privacy into our products from the ground up—bridging the legal, regulatory, and technical dimensions of privacy across the company .
This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid sche dule . If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday . Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays . Working from home on Fridays d epends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner . If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements .
What you’ll achieve
Lead technical privacy-by-design reviews for new features and major architectural changes, embedding privacy controls early in the development lifecycle across our business, data, and product infrastructure .
Help drive compliance with global privacy regulations (such as GDPR and CCPA) by translating legal requirements into concrete engineering standards, frameworks, and tooling that facilitate velocity .
Evaluate and mitigate privacy risks in AI/ML systems, including training data pipelines and model outputs .
Build and operate systems that enable data rights for our users and privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), such as data minimization and de-identification frameworks .
Conduct privacy impact assessments and threat modeling for high-risk data processing activities .
Advocate for privacy-preserving solutions, serve as a trusted technical advisor across the business, and identify new opportunities to improve our overall privacy posture .
Partner cross-functionally to ensure our privacy policies and notices accurately reflect our underlying technology .
Develop customer-facing trust documentation on privacy and support privacy incident response efforts .
Design and implement privacy-preserving analytics and measurement systems that provide actionable insights while protecting individual user privacy .
About you
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making .
6+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years focused on privacy or data protection .
Passion for privacy and data protection with a deep understanding of GDPR, CCPA, and emerging global privacy frameworks .
Proven experience building technical controls for data governance, including classification, lineage, retention, and deletion at scale .
Familiarity with privacy risks in ML systems, such as training data sourcing, model memorization, and inference privacy .
Strong foundation in privacy-by-design principles and hands-on experience applying them throughout product development .
Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory and legal requirements into clear engineering specifications .
Experience with cryptographic techniques, anonymization, and de-identification frameworks .
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a track r ecord of partnering effectively with legal, policy, and non-technical stakeholders .
At A sana, we're committed to building teams that include a varie ty of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as t his is critical t o helping us achieve our mission . If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you t o apply .
What we’ll offer Our comprehensive compensation package play s a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission . We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role . To ensure pay is fair and not i mpacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit .
For this role, the estimated base salary range will vary based on your location . Locations in the US are categorized into one of three geographic pay zones, and the ranges for the zones are as follows: Zone A: $235,000 - $267,000
Zone B: $211,000 - $240,000
Zone C: $189,000 - $216,000
For more information about which locations fall into each pay zone, please visit https://asana.com/usa-pay-zones . Please also consult your recruiter to confirm the applicable pay zone for your specific location .
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process . The listed ranges above are a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified .
In addition to base salary, your compensatio n package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits . If y ou're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation an d benefits for this role .
We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:
Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations . If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role .
About us
Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.
Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

title: Dropbox: Director, Product Design
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations
Role Description
Dropbox’s Design team is looking for a Director of Product Design to define the next generation of product experiences and infrastructure for Dropbox. In this role, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution for the systems, patterns, and operating model that shape how Dropbox builds coherent, high quality, multi product experiences at scale.
We are building a modern system that can support a broader portfolio of products, accelerate product teams to achieve product market fit, improve front end quality, and create durable patterns for the most important product experiences across Dropbox. You will lead the team responsible for turning repeated product needs into reusable experience infrastructure: interaction patterns, product frameworks, design primitives, implementation standards, and adoption models that make it easier for teams to build excellent Dropbox experiences.
As Director, you will oversee the evolution of Dropbox’s design system into a next generation design and technology platform. This includes the foundational system of components, tokens, accessibility standards, and documentation, but also the broader lifecycle of product patterns: how they are identified, designed, validated, built, adopted, measured, improved, and eventually deprecated. You will help move the team from a reactive model, where design systems patternize work after the fact, to a more proactive model, where the team helps shape core product experiences from the beginning.
You will also establish Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality. This team should not only define what good looks like, but help build it. That means partnering deeply with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, brand, and leadership to create high leverage patterns that improve product coherence, accelerate execution, and raise the quality bar across web, mobile, desktop, and emerging AI native experiences.
The ideal candidate is a systems minded design leader with excellent product judgment, strong craft standards, deep experience leading multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to operate across strategy, execution, governance, and organizational influence. You should be equally comfortable defining a long term vision for the future of design systems, reviewing the details of a complex interaction pattern, partnering with engineering on implementation quality, and helping senior leaders understand where the product experience needs stronger horizontal investment.
This is a critical leadership role for Dropbox’s multi product future. You will help define how shared product experiences are built, how teams adopt them, how quality scales, and how Dropbox creates a more coherent, intelligent, and durable product experience for customers.
Responsibilities
Define and drive the vision for Dropbox’s next generation design system, expanding it from a component library into a broader product experience platform for patterns, primitives, standards, and shared product logic.
Lead Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality, interaction patterns, accessibility, implementation standards, and cross product experience coherence.
Build and evolve reusable product patterns that drive core Dropbox experiences, including navigation, creation flows, sharing, permissions, collaboration, onboarding, search, content activation, notifications, settings, admin workflows, and AI assisted experiences.
Move the team from reactive patternization to proactive product leadership, helping identify horizontal product needs early and shaping solutions that can scale across multiple Dropbox surfaces and teams.
Own the full lifecycle of shared patterns and components, including discovery, definition, design, prototyping, engineering partnership, adoption, measurement, maintenance, governance, and deprecation.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Brand, Marketing, and Design leadership to align on the highest impact horizontal opportunities and ensure shared systems directly support product strategy.
Raise the craft and quality bar across Dropbox by improving interaction design, visual quality, information architecture, accessibility, motion, content patterns, implementation fidelity, and front end consistency.
Create an operating model that makes adoption desirable rather than mandated, ensuring product teams see the system as a way to move faster, build better, and reduce duplicated effort.
Lead and develop a team of designers, design technologists, and systems specialists, creating clear ownership, strong critique practices, high standards, and a culture of pragmatic systems thinking.
Partner with engineering leadership to improve the relationship between design systems, code, product infrastructure, and front end delivery, ensuring that design intent is translated into high quality implementation.
Establish durable governance, measurement, and contribution models that help the system evolve continuously while maintaining quality, coherence, and accountability.
Help Dropbox prepare for AI native product experiences by defining systems that can encode design knowledge, guide product decisions, and support more adaptive, contextual, and intelligent experiences over time.
Requirements
12+ years of product design, design systems, design technology, or front end experience, including significant experience leading complex systems or platform initiatives at scale.
5+ years of people management experience, with a strong track record of leading senior designers, managers, design technologists, or multidisciplinary systems teams.
Deep experience building, scaling, or transforming design systems for complex multi product organizations.
Strong product judgment and the ability to connect systems work directly to customer value, product strategy, execution speed, and business impact.
Exceptional systems thinking, with the ability to see patterns across teams, products, platforms, and workflows, then turn those patterns into reusable experience infrastructure.
High craft standards across interaction design, information architecture, visual design, accessibility, prototyping, content patterns, motion, and implementation quality.
Proven ability to influence senior cross functional partners, create alignment across ambiguous problem spaces, and drive horizontal product quality without relying on mandate alone.
Strong technical fluency and comfort partnering with front end engineering teams on component architecture, implementation standards, platform constraints, quality control, and system adoption.
Experience defining governance models, contribution models, quality standards, documentation practices, and lifecycle processes for shared product systems.
A clear point of view on the future of design systems, including how AI, design technology, design infrastructure, and reusable product logic should change how teams design and build.
A collaborative, low ego leadership style, with a track record of developing talent, raising standards, improving critique, and helping teams produce better work than they could have produced on their own.
A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates strong design leadership, systems strategy, product impact, organizational influence, and excellent taste.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading design systems, design technology, front end platform, or product infrastructure teams in a large scale, multi product organization.
Deep understanding of how to leverage content systems as part and parcel of the overall design system.
Experience building shared patterns for complex product domains such as collaboration, content management, permissions, search, productivity, AI, administration, or multi product ecosystems.
Strong technical fluency across coded systems, design tokens, component architecture, accessibility infrastructure, prototyping tools, and front end implementation quality.
A strong point of view on the future of design systems, including how AI, design technology, and reusable product logic should evolve the way teams design and build.

This role is not available in Zone 1

title: 6 Figure Creative: Remote High-Ticket Closer
description:
Headquarters: Nashville, Tennessee, United States
URL: https://6figurecreative.com/podcast/
This position offers $100K guaranteed minimum with uncapped commissions selling a $6,400 business consulting offer to leads who were generated primarily through Meta ads
Please do not apply unless you can provide real numbers from your previous sales roles.
During the interview process, be prepared to walk us through how many calls you took, how many sales you made, what the offer cost, where the leads came from, how much revenue you personally closed, and exactly how your close rate was calculated.
-----
Dear future sales rep,
We're searching for someone who is incredible at turning skeptical strangers into clients by truly understanding what is happening in their business, helping them see what needs to change, and guiding them through the fears and objections keeping them stuck.
Most of our prospects first discover us through Meta ads. By the time they reach your calendar, they have applied to speak with us and have some familiarity with our company, but most are still cold or lukewarm.
You will need to earn their trust.
You will need to diagnose the real problem.
You will need to help qualified prospects make a clear decision instead of letting them run back to the same habits that have kept their business stuck for years.
This role is a top priority at 6 Figure Creative because our entire company exists to help creative freelancers solve one giant problem:
They have no idea where their next client is coming from.
Everything we do is designed to help them solve that problem permanently by building a repeatable client acquisition system.
We're an established, profitable company doing roughly $2.5 million in annual revenue, with a consistent paid acquisition engine generating sales opportunities primarily through Meta ads.
We know there is significantly more upside available with the right person in this seat, so we're looking for a proven closer who can help us raise the bar for the entire sales team.
Why we are offering a $100K guaranteed minimum
Most remote sales jobs throw out a giant OTE number, give you no guarantee whatsoever, and make you absorb all the risk of joining a company you have never worked with before.
We are doing something different.
We want someone with a real, documented track record who already has other options.
We also understand that joining a smaller sales team is a risk. You do not know yet how good our leads are, how strong the offer is, how the company operates, or whether the opportunity is as good as we say it is.
So we are taking most of that downside off your plate.
You will receive a guaranteed minimum of $100,000 per year while keeping the full upside of our existing uncapped commission structure.
To be completely clear, this is not a $100,000 salary plus commissions.
Each month, you receive whichever amount is greater:
$8,333.33 in guaranteed compensation
The commissions you earned that month
There is no negative draw balance.
You never owe the guarantee back.
If your commissions exceed the guarantee, you receive the higher commission amount.
The guarantee does not mean the performance standard is lower. It means we are willing to take a real financial risk to attract someone capable of raising it.
If you are looking for a comfortable $100,000 job where you can close 15% of your calls and hide, this is not that job.
If you perform at the level your track record suggests, the guaranteed minimum should eventually stop mattering because your commissions will be higher.
What You'll Do
As our Remote High-Ticket Closer, your primary responsibility is converting qualified prospects into clients for our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint.
You will conduct consultative enrollment calls over Zoom, diagnose the prospect's business challenges, determine whether they are a strong fit, clearly explain how we can help, and confidently ask qualified prospects to enroll.
These are not random cold calls.
The prospects have applied to speak with us, but most were originally generated through paid Meta ads and will not arrive fully sold.
Once a prospect lands on your calendar, you own that opportunity from preparation through follow-up and final decision.
Your main responsibilities include:
1: Enrollment calls:
You will spend most of your time helping prospects determine whether our consulting sprint is right for them.
If they truly need our help and are a strong fit, you should see it as your responsibility to help them make the decision instead of allowing fear, uncertainty, or a weak objection to send them back to the same situation they wanted to escape.
That means you will:
Review every application before the call
Diagnose the real issues inside the prospect's business
Understand their goals, urgency, financial situation, and readiness
Determine whether they are a strong fit for our consulting sprint
Clearly explain our process, expectations, and investment
Make a direct recommendation when you believe they should enroll
Handle objections with empathy, patience, and confidence
Disqualify prospects who are not a good fit
Avoid enrolling obvious red-flag or high-risk clients just to hit a sales number
2: CRM and lead ownership
You will take complete ownership of every lead assigned to you inside GoHighLevel.
No qualified opportunity should be lost because of weak follow-up, incomplete notes, or an unclear next step.
That means you will:
Keep every opportunity stage accurate
Complete detailed notes after every call
Record the outcome and next step for every prospect
Complete all required follow-up on time
Reschedule qualified prospects who miss their calls
Work no-shows through our recovery process
Continue following up until the prospect enrolls, declines, or is formally closed out
Keep your sales data accurate enough that we never have to guess what is happening inside your pipeline
3: Call review and improvement
Every enrollment call is recorded.
You should already be excellent at sales when you join us. Call review here is about sharpening strong performance, identifying patterns, testing better approaches, and turning individual wins into improvements the entire sales team can use.
You will regularly review your own calls, participate in team call reviews and roleplay, and bring useful insights from your conversations back to the rest of the company.
That means you will:
Review your own calls and identify specific areas to improve
Bring useful wins, losses, and difficult calls to team call reviews
Give and receive direct, thoughtful feedback
Test new approaches instead of relying on the same script forever
Apply what we learn to future calls
Help identify patterns in objections, lead quality, messaging, and offer positioning
Share what is working so the entire sales team improves alongside you
4: Improve the company's sales process
You will work closely with me, the founder, to continuously improve our offer, messaging, scripts, follow-up, and overall sales process.
You are talking directly to the market every day. That makes your feedback extremely valuable.
You will help us:
Identify recurring objections and concerns
Find weaknesses in our messaging or offer
Improve our enrollment call structure
Improve email and text follow-up
Reduce the time between the first call and the final decision
Share useful insights with our marketing and consulting teams
Build a stronger sales system for everyone who joins after you
What Success In This Role Looks Like
We are hiring someone who can raise the bar, not just hit the current one.
Within six months, the expectation is that you are handling approximately 70 to 80 completed sales calls per month and maintaining a 30% or greater close rate.
A 35% or greater close rate would be exceptional.
We expect a fast ramp:
9 or more new clients in your first full production month
12 or more in your second full production month
15 or more in your third full production month
Your first-year target is at least 225 new clients, with 250 or more as the goal.
Who you'll work with
You will report directly to me (Brian Hood), the founder and person writing this job description.
You will also work alongside a veteran closer who has been with the company for 3+ years.
We are not a 40-person boiler room where you are handed a script, dropped into a Slack channel, and treated like rep number 37.
You will have direct access to the person who can actually change the offer, marketing, script, follow-up process, or sales system when something is not working.
See what you'd be selling
This role is easier to evaluate when you can see the actual offer and the proof behind it.
Review the Clients By Design program overview
See what clients have produced from their paid-ad campaigns
Why apply for this job?
If you're an experienced sales rep who wants to use your skills to help transform the lives of creatives who run freelance businesses, this job might be the perfect fit for you.
Our clients include Grammy-winning music producers, designers, videographers, and other creative freelancers.
Despite being extremely talented at their craft, they have never been taught how to consistently find and close clients.
The decision you help them make on a sales call can completely change their career.
Not only will you be affecting the lives and businesses of the people you enroll in our consulting program, but you'll also be impacting each and every client they work with as well.
If you're a high performer who's been stuck in a toxic sales team and you want to help create a healthy, thriving sales culture, you'll love being able to help us build out the sales team from the ground up and set the right culture from day one.
If you've spent years selling products you don't believe in , this is an opportunity to use your talent on something that genuinely helps people build better businesses and lives.
If you are tired of being one of dozens of closers with no influence over anything upstream, you will have direct access to the founder and a real voice in how we improve the company.
If you want the upside of commission without gambling your income while learning a completely new company, offer, and lead source, that is exactly why we created the guaranteed minimum.
Where you'll work
Our entire company operates remotely, with a diverse team spread across the United States, Portugal, England, Romania, Israel, and South Korea.
You can work from home, a quiet coworking space, or anywhere else with reliable internet and a professional place to take calls.
You must be available to take calls during U.S. business hours and have a setup where prospects will not hear dogs barking, roommates yelling, or a coffee grinder running during their enrollment call.
What We Do At 6 Figure Creative (And Why We Do It)
6 Figure Creative is a business consultancy for creative freelancers who are stuck relying on referrals, word of mouth, inconsistent content, or last-minute desperate outreach to find clients.
Our mission is to help creatives earn more without selling their souls.
Our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint helps freelancers build and implement a repeatable system for attracting and closing clients.
We believe that the education system is fundamentally broken. Universities will gladly charge their students $100k+ for a creative degree and never teach them the most important skills and strategies for how to actually get an ROI from their investment.
The consulting program you'll be selling exists to help the best creatives in the world change the trajectory of their careers (and lives) by learning the skills universities failed to teach them.
It takes more than passion to succeed, and everything we do is built around giving our clients the strategies, tools, processes, guidance, consulting, and accountability they need to have successful businesses.
If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, apply below.
I look forward to working with you

Today, most marketing communications are planned weeks in advance on a calendar based on dates and internal priorities. Each email, push, campaign takes 3-5 people and dozens of steps to create. Our customers come to us looking to transform the way they do marketing: using AI agents to rapidly learn about consumer preferences and deliver highly effective marketing and product experiences to each customer 1:1.
As an AI Strategy Consultant, you are the trusted technical–strategic partner for our AI Decisioning customers. You own the bridge between what the product can do and what the customer’s business needs — from discovery through go‑live and expansion.
You’ll work with as a part of a driven and creative team of ML + product engineers, product designers, and other Strategy Consultants to deploy new use cases with the largest customer-facing brands in the world. title: A Book of Your Own
description:
Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission.
It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you.
I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes.
It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages.
There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips
Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book.
Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own?
Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject?
Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book.
Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book.
